notes:
### Diagnostics

- Dorcel stalls are now tracked as individual events with a unique event ID, start time, duration and final cause classification.
- Stall classification distinguishes SOURCE_CONFIRMED, KODI_LIKELY, WIFI_LIKELY, MIXED and UNKNOWN using manifest state, media-sequence movement, HTTP errors, Kodi cache/player behavior and network evidence.
- The first stall after startup is now included in the event diagnostics so short early freezes can be compared between runs.
- Wi-Fi diagnostics now include additional RX/TX error and drop information, plus a local-gateway reachability check when available during a stall.

### Recovery

- 1 h and 2 h Dorcel tests can now request a fresh session when a real playback stall is accompanied by a confirmed source failure such as HTTP 404, a media-sequence reset or repeatedly stale manifest state.
- Normal periodic 5-minute stalls remain conservative and are not automatically restarted unless source-failure evidence is present.
- Existing recovery cooldown and handoff locking remain active to prevent duplicate restart loops.

### Hourly Handoff Diagnostics

- Planned Dorcel session transitions now log a handoff ID, handoff start and measured playback-resume gap.
- Test summaries now include stall counts by cause, first-stall offset and hourly handoff statistics so long unattended tests can show whether the hourly transition was seamless or visible.

### Important

- Auto Channels Check, Site/IPTV behavior, One Channel, automatic log saving, Save Log Only, Shutdown/Sleep, Check Lock and AlarmClock/watchdog remain otherwise unchanged.
